analysis_role: Final combined public-data falsification of the fixed transition-regime H1. Apply both prior stress conditions simultaneously: linear latitude/longitude residualization of BIO15/BIO1 and internal-edge-only scoring.

fixed_hypothesis.question: Does U->D transition probability remain aligned with the fixed composite regime when simple linear geography and terminal-edge contribution are both removed at once?

method.geography: OLS residualize each taxon-centroid BIO15 and BIO1 against intercept + latitude + longitude within panel; z-score residuals
method.ctmc: same full-tree symmetric two-state CTMC with q refit for every count-preserving state map
method.continuous: Brownian squared-change reconstruction on geography-residualized environmental values
method.scoring: internal child edges only; terminal child edges excluded from numerator and denominator
method.statistic: (S_residBIO15 - S_residBIO1)/sqrt(2), median across six accepted topologies
method.null: all count-preserving state maps, observed included

decision_rule.supported: strict n>=10 composite positive on all six topologies and exact one-sided fraction <=0.05
decision_rule.directional_not_exceptional: strict composite positive 6/6 but exact fraction >0.05
decision_rule.combined_stress_breaks_direction: at least one strict topology composite <=0

stop_rule: After this fixed combined test, do not add further coarse environmental predictors or post-result robustness variants to rescue or strengthen H1. Further causal resolution requires new focal mediator/fitness or event-linked historical data.
claim_ceiling: This is post-result robustness, not independent confirmation.
Passing jointly rules out only the conjunction of simple linear geography and terminal-edge-only explanation under the declared reconstruction.
Reconstructed internal residual environments are not observed ancestral environments.
No result establishes climate causation, selection, adaptation, convergence, or physiological mechanism.
